answer_1.quote: we formulate SVHR as a generation task ... we propose the Guided Generative Model (GGM), which leverages the retrieved hashtag to augment the input for hashtag generation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE metrics ... ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2 F1 are used to measure the ngram overlaps. ... we also include the BERTScore to compute the semantic similarity of the hashtags.

answer_4.quote: we randomly sample 100 novel hashtags created by GGM and manually evaluate their understandability and relevancy. ... Each sample is evaluated by three people, and we average the three scores as the final result.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each hashtag on a scale of one to five for understandability and relevancy.
